# Demographics

Prep work space and load packages

```{r}
source("00_setup.R")
```

Load CHILDES transcripts/ utterance dataframe in English-North America

```{r,echo=TRUE, results="show"}
d_eng_na  <- readRDS(here("01Data", "01Childes", "d_eng_na_transcripts.rds"))
ut_eng_na <- readRDS(here("01Data", "01Childes", "ut_eng_na_utterances.rds"))
head(ut_eng_na)

```

Exclude corpora that do not meet inclusion criteria (data quality / scope). `d_eng_na`, `ut_eng_na`, and `d_target_child` are overwritten in place so that all downstream code runs on the filtered dataset without any further changes.

Exclusion criteria: corpora involving clinical populations, including children with focal lesions (Feldman & Holland, 1989) and visual impairment (Wilson & Peters, 1988)

```{r corpus-exclusion, echo=TRUE, results="show"}
EXCLUDE_CORPORA <- c("Feldman",    
                     "Peters")  

d_eng_na  <- d_eng_na  %>% filter(!corpus_name %in% EXCLUDE_CORPORA)
ut_eng_na <- ut_eng_na %>% filter(!corpus_name %in% EXCLUDE_CORPORA)

cat(sprintf("\nAfter exclusion: %d transcripts | %d corpora\n",
            n_distinct(d_eng_na$transcript_id),
            n_distinct(d_eng_na$corpus_name)))
```

Load participant information: Number of Transcripts, transcripts, utterances by roles

```{r,echo=TRUE, results="show"}
ut_eng_na %>%
  summarise(
    n_corpora     = n_distinct(corpus_name),
    n_transcripts = n_distinct(transcript_id),
    n_children    = n_distinct(target_child_id)
  )

count_by_role <- ut_eng_na %>%
  group_by(speaker_role) %>%
  summarise(
  n_speakers   = n_distinct(speaker_id),
  n_transcripts = n_distinct(transcript_id),
  n_utterances = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) 
#Order by number of transcripts
count_by_role <- count_by_role %>%
  arrange(desc(n_transcripts)) %>%
  mutate(
    speaker_role = factor(speaker_role,
                          levels = speaker_role)
  )

# Total number of distinct speaker roles (excluding target child)
n_roles <- count_by_role %>%
  filter(speaker_role != "Target_Child") %>%
  nrow()
n_roles

count_by_role

count_by_role_exc_child <- count_by_role %>% 
  filter(speaker_role != "Target_Child")

count_by_role_exc_child
```

Pie Chart showing number of transcripts by role excluding target child

```{r}
p_role_dist <- ggplot(count_by_role_exc_child,
       aes(x = "", y = n_transcripts, fill = speaker_role)) +
  geom_col(width = 1) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Transcripts by Role")

p_role_dist

ggsave(
  here("03Output", "fig_role_distribution.png"),
  plot = p_role_dist,
  width = 6,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

### Group conversational partners

Grouping based on Bronfenbrenner’s ecological systems

Group 1: Mother (MOT)

Group 2: Father (FAT)

Group 3: Adult with existing relationship (ADT): Teacher,Grandmother, Relative,Grandfather, Caretaker, Target_Adult

Group 4: Siblings (SIB): Sister, Brother,Sibling

Group 5: Other children (OTH_C): Child, Friend, Playmate, Boy, Girl, Student

Group 6: Other adults (OTH_A) : Investigator, Participants, Adult,Unidentified, Other, Media, Visitor, Environment,Male, Female, Group, Doctor, Uncertain

```{r}
source(here("02Script", "03RoleMap.R"))

count_by_role_exc_child <- count_by_role_exc_child %>%
  left_join(role_category_map, by = "speaker_role")
count_by_role <- count_by_role %>% 
  left_join(role_category_map, by = "speaker_role")

count_by_role_exc_child

#Sanity check 
count_by_role %>%
  filter(is.na(role_category)) %>%
  distinct(speaker_role)
```

Number of participant, transcripts, utterance by each category

```{r}
count_by_category <- count_by_role %>%
  group_by(role_category) %>%
  summarise(
    n_speakers    = sum(n_speakers),
    n_transcripts = sum(n_transcripts),
    n_utterances  = sum(n_utterances),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_transcripts))

count_by_category
```

Load information on the target child: number of target child, sex, age

```{r,echo=TRUE, results="show"}
d_target_child <- readRDS(here("01Data", "01Childes", "d_target_child.rds")) %>%
  filter(!corpus_name %in% EXCLUDE_CORPORA)

sum_sex <- d_target_child %>%
  count(sex)
sum_sex

sum_age <-d_target_child %>%
  summarise(
    mean_age = mean(min_age, na.rm = TRUE),

  )
sum_age
```

### Child age distribution

Age distribution across transcripts, and count of participants with missing age information.

```{r age-distribution, echo=TRUE, results="show"}
# Age distribution at the transcript level
age_dist <- ut_eng_na %>%
  distinct(transcript_id, target_child_id, target_child_age) %>%
  summarise(
    n_transcripts    = n(),
    n_children       = n_distinct(target_child_id),
    missing_age_tr   = sum(is.na(target_child_age)),
    pct_missing_age  = round(mean(is.na(target_child_age)) * 100, 1),
    mean_age         = round(mean(target_child_age, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    sd_age           = round(sd(target_child_age,   na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    min_age          = round(min(target_child_age,  na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    max_age          = round(max(target_child_age,  na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  )
print(age_dist)

# Participants (unique children) with missing age in at least one transcript
missing_age_children <- ut_eng_na %>%
  distinct(target_child_id, target_child_age) %>%
  group_by(target_child_id) %>%
  summarise(any_missing = any(is.na(target_child_age)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  summarise(
    n_missing_children = sum(any_missing),
    n_total_children   = n()
  )
print(missing_age_children)

cat(sprintf(
  "\nChild age information was missing for %d participants (%d transcripts, %.1f%%).\n",
  missing_age_children$n_missing_children,
  age_dist$missing_age_tr,
  age_dist$pct_missing_age
))

# Histogram of age distribution (observed only)
p_age_dist <- ut_eng_na %>%
  distinct(transcript_id, target_child_age) %>%
  filter(!is.na(target_child_age)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = target_child_age)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 6, fill = "#4a90d9", colour = "white") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name   = "Child age (months)",
    breaks = seq(0, 150, 12)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Child Age Across Transcripts",
    y     = "Number of transcripts"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_age_dist

ggsave(
  here("03Output", "fig_age_distribution.png"),
  plot   = p_age_dist,
  width  = 8,
  height = 4,
  dpi    = 300
)
```

### Missing data diagnostics

Missing child age and sex at the transcript level (using utterance data, one row per transcript)

```{r, echo=TRUE, results="show"}
onlychild_ids <- ut_eng_na %>%
  group_by(transcript_id) %>%
  summarise(
    only_child = all(na.omit(speaker_code) == "CHI"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(only_child) %>%
  pull(transcript_id)

#sanity check
length(onlychild_ids)               # how many such transcripts

miss_demo <- ut_eng_na %>%
  distinct(transcript_id, target_child_age, target_child_sex) %>%
  summarise(
    n_transcripts   = n(),
    missing_age     = sum(is.na(target_child_age)),
    pct_missing_age = round(mean(is.na(target_child_age)) * 100, 1),
    missing_sex     = sum(is.na(target_child_sex)),
    pct_missing_sex = round(mean(is.na(target_child_sex)) * 100, 1)
  )
print(miss_demo)

# Final n after excluding only-child transcripts AND missing age
n_after_excl <- miss_demo$n_transcripts -
  length(onlychild_ids) -
  miss_demo$missing_age
cat(sprintf(
  "Transcripts after excluding only-child (%d) and missing age (%d): %d\n",
  length(onlychild_ids), miss_demo$missing_age, n_after_excl
))
```

Sex distribution in the age-complete subset (before imputation; imputed values are added in the analysis script)

```{r, echo=TRUE, results="show"}
sex_obs <- ut_eng_na %>%
  distinct(transcript_id, target_child_age, target_child_sex) %>%
  filter(!is.na(target_child_age)) %>%          # same exclusion as analysis
  count(target_child_sex, name = "n_transcripts") %>%
  mutate(pct = round(n_transcripts / sum(n_transcripts) * 100, 1))
print(sex_obs)
```

### Conversational partner categories per transcript

Number of transcripts with Target Child + exactly 1 partner category vs. more than 1 (using the processed emotion dataset)

```{r, echo=TRUE, results="show"}
utt_pe <- readRDS(here("01Data", "02Derived", "utt_partners_emotions.rds"))

partner_category_counts <- utt_pe %>%
  filter(speaker_code != "CHI") %>%           # count partner categories only
  group_by(transcript_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_partner_categories = n_distinct(role_category, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

partner_summary <- partner_category_counts %>%
  mutate(partner_group = ifelse(
    n_partner_categories == 1,
    "Target Child + 1 partner category",
    "Target Child + >1 partner categories"
  )) %>%
  count(partner_group, name = "n_transcripts") %>%
  mutate(pct = round(n_transcripts / sum(n_transcripts) * 100, 1))

print(partner_summary)
```

```{r}
library(gt)
library(dplyr)

demo_table <- tibble(
  Partner       = c("Mother", "Father", "Other Adult", "Known Adult"),
  Transcripts   = c(1293, 188, 396, 101),
  Children      = c(310, 14, 99, 4),
  Age_Range     = c("0.25–10.3", "1.3–4.8", "1.0–9.4", "2.0–5.4"),
  Female        = c(143, 3, 47, 1),
  Male          = c(159, 9, 48, 0),
  Unknown       = c(8, 2, 4, 3)
) %>%
  mutate(
    Female  = paste0(Female,  " (", round(Female  / Children * 100), "%)"),
    Male    = paste0(Male,    " (", round(Male    / Children * 100), "%)"),
    Unknown = paste0(Unknown, " (", round(Unknown / Children * 100), "%)")
  )

demo_table %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(
    Partner   = "Partner",
    Transcripts = "Transcripts",
    Children  = "Children",
    Age_Range = "Age Range (years)",
    Female    = "Female",
    Male      = "Male",
    Unknown   = "Unknown"
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label   = "Child Sex, *n* (%)",
    columns = c(Female, Male, Unknown)
  ) %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("*Descriptive Statistics of Transcripts by Conversational Partner Type*")
  ) %>%
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = md("*Note.* Children = number of unique target children. Age range is reported in years. Unknown = child sex not recorded in CHILDES.")
  ) %>%
  opt_table_lines("none") %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(sides = c("top", "bottom"), weight = px(2)),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(sides = "top", weight = px(2)),
    locations = cells_title()
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(sides = "bottom", weight = px(2)),
    locations = cells_body(rows = nrow(demo_table))
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = Transcripts, decimals = 0)
```
